summary: Manages an organisation's cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, compliance, and executive alignment.
Monitors, detects, analyses, contains, and responds to cybersecurity incidents and active threats across systems and networks.

role: Cyber Legal, Policy and Compliance Officer
summary: Advises on cybersecurity laws, data protection regulations, internal policies, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Collects, analyses, correlates, and disseminates actionable intelligence on cyber threats, threat actors, and attack indicators.
Plans, designs, and reviews secure-by-design architectures and technical controls for networks, cloud environments, systems, and applications.
Performs independent audits and assessments of security controls, policies, and processes against standards and regulatory requirements.
Designs, develops, and delivers cybersecurity training, awareness programmes, and educational curricula to build workforce capabilities.
Deploys, configures, integrates, hardens, and maintains cybersecurity solutions, infrastructure, and secure software components.
Investigates emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, cryptographic methods, and defensive technologies to advance cybersecurity knowledge.
Identifies, assesses, quantifies, and treats organisational cybersecurity and third-party risks in alignment with business objectives.
Acquires, preserves, analyses, and reports on digital evidence and malware artifacts following security incidents or legal investigations.
Simulates adversarial attacks and conducts authorised security assessments to uncover and demonstrate exploitable vulnerabilities in systems and applications.
